content.title: UConn Huskies vs. Michigan Wolverines: Where to Watch NCAA Men’s National Championship Game Live Online
content.text: Skip to main content site categories Home TV TV News UConn Huskies vs. Michigan Wolverines: Where to Watch NCAA Men’s National Championship Game Live Online Livestream the college basketball final tournament game on Monday, Apr. 6. CHICAGO, ILLINOIS - MARCH 14: Yaxel Lendeborg #23 of the Michigan Wolverines celebrates his game-winning three-pointer against the Wisconsin Badgers with teammates Morez Johnson Jr. #21 and Elliot Cadeau #3 during the semifinals of the 2026 Big Ten Men's Basketball Tournament at the United Center on March 14, 2026 in Chicago, Illinois. Geoff Stellfox/Getty Images With the UCLA Bruins winning the women’s college basketball tournament against the South Carolina Gamecocks, it’s now the men’s turn for the NCAA March Madness’ final game, which takes place on Monday, Apr. 6. The top two teams in college basketball compete for the NCAA Division I Men’s Basketball National Championship Trophy. At the end of the Final Four, you can watch the national championship game with the No. 2-ranked UConn Huskies takes on the No. 1-ranked Michigan Wolverines at Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis, Indiana with tipoff at 5:50 p.m. PT/8:50 p.m. ET. The final broadcast on TBS and truTV, and livestream on HBO Max. Related Stories At a Glance: How to Stream the National Championship 2026: NCAA Men’s March Madness Online When: Apr. 6 Channels: TBS and truTV Stream online: DirecTV, HBO Max, Hulu + Live TV, Sling TV If you want to catch all of the college basketball action, keep reading to find out how to watch the UConn-Michigan game with and without a cable subscription, including ways to watch for free. How to Watch the National Championship Game 2026: NCAA Men’s March Madness Without Cable The UConn vs. Michigan game airs on TBS and truTV, while game livestreams on HBO Max. Moreover, the networks TBS and truTV are also available via web-based cable alternative services, including DirecTV, Hulu + Live TV and Sling TV — some of which offer free trials. Ahead, find out how to watch the tournament final with and without a cable subscription. DirecTV One of the best ways to watch the game is on DirecTV. The cable alternative’s “MySports” package offers TBS and truTV, plus more than 20 other channels. In addition, the streamer has a five-day free trial available, while you can either cancel or keep the service after the free trial is over, with prices starting at $44.99 for the first two months of service ($69.99 per month afterwards). Meanwhile, DirecTV is offering three months of HBO Max for free when you signup for one of its signature packages with prices starting at $89.99 per month — after a five-day free trial. In fact, you can add up to three months of MGM+, Starz and other premium services at no additional cost. Courtesy of WBD HBO Max HBO Max has the B/R Sports add-on for free, as part of its streaming service. Available through Prime Video, HBO Max’s sports hub has access to the UConn-Michigan game starting at $10.99 per month; note that a Prime Membership ($14.99 monthly or $139 annually) or Prime Video subscription ($8.99 monthly) is required.In addition, HBO Max includes NHL on TNT, U.S. Soccer, MotoGP and other sports leagues. The service has hit movies like Sinners, One Battle After Another, Barbie, The Zone of Interest, Wonka, Avatar: The Way of Water and others, as well as award-winning series, such as The Last of Us, Hacks, The White Lotus and others. Hulu + Live TV Stream TBS and truTV on Hulu + Live TV for free with 3-day free trial. The streaming service has access to more than 95 live channels — like TBS and truTV — starting at $89.99 per month and comes with Hulu’s entire streaming library, as well as Disney+ and ESPN Unlimited. Right now, Hulu + Live TV offers a three-day free trial, so you can watch for free. Sling Stream TBS and truTV, on Sling’s Orange package. With prices starting at $4.99 for the streamer’s 1-day pass, the Sling Orange package includes TBS and truTV for NCAA National Championship game. Sling currently does not offer a free trial. Please note: Pricing and channel availability varies from TV market-to-TV market. Learn more about Sling Orange here. How to Watch the National Championship Game 2026: NCAA Men’s March Madness With Cable The UConn Huskies vs. Michigan Wolverines game broadcasts across TBS and truTV in the U.S. You can watch those channels online on their respective websites by logging in with your cable TV provider account.
